description: Ask the assigned TypeSafe Jev model bounded questions or score an authorized directory listing against a search criterion.
skill_summary: Use JSON for open-ended decisions, or let the directory tool enumerate and score names without listing them to the working agent first. Scores do not verify file contents.
migration_note: Native Rust adapter uses the agent's explicit Decision model role and its current V3 credential. TypeSafe is the supported transport. No V2 secret or code is used.
